title: Dogs That Know When Their Owners Are Coming Home and animal earthquake warnings

tellings.quote: animals that have these abilities better than humans and that was the subject of my book dogs that know when their owners are coming home

plain: A scientist named Rupert Sheldrake says some animals have abilities that are stronger than ours, such as sensing things before they happen. He says this was the subject of his own book, Dogs That Know When Their Owners Are Coming Home, which looks at pets that seem to know when someone is on the way home and at animals that seem to warn of earthquakes. If true, it would mean animals can pick up on things that science cannot yet explain.
